description: Use this when the user asks to list Launchpad keyword gaps. Returns only data visible to the linked Market Brew account.

query.description: Optional filters: customerId, websiteIds (comma-separated numeric IDs; mutually exclusive with websiteId/serverHost), websiteId, serverHost, keyword, source, maxSimilarity, sortBy, sortDir, offset, and pageSize. Omit website selectors for all authorized websites. sortBy=website orders by hostname; pagination spans the selected websites.

name: list_launchpad_keyword_gaps
title: List Launchpad keyword gaps
